scene.label: Act 4, Scene 6
scene.title: SCENE VI. Another room in the Garter Inn
scene.location: Another room in the Garter Inn

lines.text: Master Fenton, talk not to me. My mind is heavy. I will give over all.
lines.plainText: Master Fenton talk not to me My mind is heavy I will give over all

lines.text: Yet hear me speak. Assist me in my purpose,
lines.plainText: Yet hear me speak Assist me in my purpose

lines.text: And, as I am a gentleman, I'll give thee
lines.plainText: And as I am a gentleman I'll give thee

lines.text: A hundred pound in gold more than your loss.
lines.plainText: A hundred pound in gold more than your loss

lines.text: I will hear you, Master Fenton, and I will, at the least, keep your counsel.
lines.plainText: I will hear you Master Fenton and I will at the least keep your counsel

lines.text: From time to time I have acquainted you
lines.plainText: From time to time I have acquainted you

lines.text: With the dear love I bear to fair Anne Page,
lines.plainText: With the dear love I bear to fair Anne Page

lines.text: Who mutually hath answered my affection,
lines.plainText: Who mutually hath answered my affection

lines.text: So far forth as herself might be her chooser,
lines.plainText: So far forth as herself might be her chooser

lines.text: Even to my wish. I have a letter from her
lines.plainText: Even to my wish I have a letter from her

lines.text: Of such contents as you will wonder at,
lines.plainText: Of such contents as you will wonder at

lines.text: The mirth whereof so larded with my matter
lines.plainText: The mirth whereof so larded with my matter

lines.text: That neither singly can be manifested
lines.plainText: That neither singly can be manifested

lines.text: Without the show of both, wherein fat Falstaff
lines.plainText: Without the show of both wherein fat Falstaff

lines.text: Hath a great scene; the image of the jest
lines.plainText: Hath a great scene the image of the jest

lines.text: I'll show you here at large. Hark, good mine host:
lines.plainText: I'll show you here at large Hark good mine host

lines.text: Tonight at Herne's oak, just 'twixt twelve and one,
lines.plainText: Tonight at Herne's oak just 'twixt twelve and one

lines.text: Must my sweet Nan present the Fairy Queen—
lines.plainText: Must my sweet Nan present the Fairy Queen

lines.text: The purpose why is here—in which disguise,
lines.plainText: The purpose why is herein which disguise

lines.text: While other jests are something rank on foot,
lines.plainText: While other jests are something rank on foot

lines.text: Her father hath commanded her to slip
lines.plainText: Her father hath commanded her to slip

lines.text: Away with Slender, and with him at Eton
lines.plainText: Away with Slender and with him at Eton

lines.text: Immediately to marry. She hath consented. Now, sir,
lines.plainText: Immediately to marry She hath consented Now sir

lines.text: Her mother, even strong against that match
lines.plainText: Her mother even strong against that match

lines.text: And firm for Doctor Caius, hath appointed
lines.plainText: And firm for Doctor Caius hath appointed

lines.text: That he shall likewise shuffle her away,
lines.plainText: That he shall likewise shuffle her away

lines.text: While other sports are tasking of their minds,
lines.plainText: While other sports are tasking of their minds

lines.text: And at the dean'ry, where a priest attends,
lines.plainText: And at the dean'ry where a priest attends

lines.text: Straight marry her. To this her mother's plot
lines.plainText: Straight marry her To this her mother's plot

lines.text: She, seemingly obedient, likewise hath
lines.plainText: She seemingly obedient likewise hath

lines.text: Made promise to the doctor. Now thus it rests:
lines.plainText: Made promise to the doctor Now thus it rests

lines.text: Her father means she shall be all in white
lines.plainText: Her father means she shall be all in white

lines.text: And in that habit, when Slender sees his time
lines.plainText: And in that habit when Slender sees his time

lines.text: To take her by the hand and bid her go,
lines.plainText: To take her by the hand and bid her go

lines.text: She shall go with him. Her mother hath intended
lines.plainText: She shall go with him Her mother hath intended

lines.text: The better to denote her to the doctor,
lines.plainText: The better to denote her to the doctor

lines.text: For they must all be masked and vizarded—
lines.plainText: For they must all be masked and vizarded

lines.text: That quaint in green she shall be loose enrobed,
lines.plainText: That quaint in green she shall be loose enrobed

lines.text: With ribbons pendant flaring 'bout her head;
lines.plainText: With ribbons pendant flaring 'bout her head

lines.text: And when the doctor spies his vantage ripe,
lines.plainText: And when the doctor spies his vantage ripe

lines.text: To pinch her by the hand, and on that token
lines.plainText: To pinch her by the hand and on that token

lines.text: The maid hath given consent to go with him.
lines.plainText: The maid hath given consent to go with him

lines.text: Which means she to deceive, father or mother?
lines.plainText: Which means she to deceive father or mother

lines.text: Both, my good host, to go along with me.
lines.plainText: Both my good host to go along with me

lines.text: And here it rests, that you'll procure the vicar
lines.plainText: And here it rests that you'll procure the vicar

lines.text: To stay for me at church, 'twixt twelve and one,
lines.plainText: To stay for me at church 'twixt twelve and one

lines.text: And, in the lawful name of marrying,
lines.plainText: And in the lawful name of marrying

lines.text: To give our hearts united ceremony.
lines.plainText: To give our hearts united ceremony

lines.text: Well, husband your device; I'll to the vicar.
lines.plainText: Well husband your device I'll to the vicar

lines.text: Bring you the maid, you shall not lack a priest.
lines.plainText: Bring you the maid you shall not lack a priest

lines.text: So shall I evermore be bound to thee;
lines.plainText: So shall I evermore be bound to thee

lines.text: Besides, I'll make a present recompense.
lines.plainText: Besides I'll make a present recompense
